scope: The 276-system categorical known-truth mechanism programme in PR #27.
trigger: The pre-frozen v0.5/v0.5.1 state-balance aggregate has been opened and recorded, activating the unconditional stop rule in data/phylo_memory_mechanism_stop_v0_5_2.json.

final_stage_summary.structural_realizability: rho=0.15 is explicitly realizable by at least one one-transition binary edge split in 276/276 categorical trees; 0/220 original OU no-bracket systems have an edge-split ceiling below the target.
final_stage_summary.latent_ou_accessibility: 220/276 categorical systems are no-bracket under latent-OU thresholding; among those, 195/220 never reach rho=0.15 even without the valid-fraction rule and 25/220 reach it only after validity falls below 0.90.
final_stage_summary.generator_dependence: Symmetric Mk2 reduces no-bracket from 220/276 (79.7%) to 170/276 (61.6%), rescuing 51/220 OU no-bracket systems while creating one new failure.
final_stage_summary.state_balance_attenuation: Among 272 exact geometry matches, balance normalization rescues 50/167 Mk2-rho no-bracket systems and creates zero new failures; with four pre-outcome geometry holds, the full-population no-bracket rate is bounded at 42.4%-43.8%.
final_stage_summary.recovery_after_assignment: Under Mk2, 37/106 calibrated systems fail the frozen recovery gate (34.9%), so accessibility and recovery are distinct limitations.

primary_claim: A declared known truth is not automatically an assignable truth. For constrained representations, valid simulation-based power inference requires separating structural realizability, generator accessibility, and estimator recovery before interpreting failure as low power.
unresolved_remainder: Approximately 42%-44% of the categorical population remains no-bracket after the frozen generator substitution and algebraic state-balance diagnostic. Under the stop rule this is retained as an unresolved generator-partition-alignment remainder rather than pursued by further estimator or parameter search on the same systems.
prohibited_after_close: execute the older alternative-estimator v0.4 route as primary evidence
search additional generators or estimators on these 276 systems
extend OU or Mk2 parameter grids after observing outcomes
filter systems based on mechanism outcomes
allowed_after_close: artifact/provenance corrections without changing scientific thresholds
independent replication on independently frozen data or geometries
